purpose: Keep T2 recall broad, but prevent one hot subchain from flooding the formal common qualification pool with near-duplicate companies.

weekly_deep_review.rule: A company independently validated by the weekly deep review remains eligible. It consumes a representative slot for any T2 subchain it belongs to, so the T2-only path cannot refill the same chain with duplicates.

ranking.rule: Representative selection balances absolute profit scale with current earnings transmission. Profit scale is deliberately weighted heavily so low-base percentage growth cannot crowd out established industry representatives. The step ranks only companies that already passed the company-level future-earnings gate and never uses valuation or right-side technical structure, preserving stage independence.

output_policy.rule: Deferred companies remain visible in future_earnings_gate for auditability but are excluded from common_pool_codes. Multi-tag companies remain subject to every subchain cap; winning one chain cannot be used to overfill another.
